primary_estimand: Within-person change in vastus lateralis muscle transcriptome after 12 weeks of supervised resistance training (POST vs PRE), untrained pre-menopausal females. Intervention (exercise) effect on gene expression, estimated with each participant as her own control.
inclusion: Paper: 35 recruited, 27 completed training (S2.2.p1). Fig. 7 legend: n = 35 pre-training, 27 post-training. GEO deposits 57 samples (31 PRE, 26 POST). All deposited samples kept, as the paper's ~ID + timepoint model pools them.
paper_method: DESeq2, Genes ~ ID + timepoint; ID = repeated-measures subject (S2.14.p6); significance FDR-adjusted P < 0.05 (S2.14.p7); no fold-change cutoff stated
paper_results: 214 transcripts DE pre vs post (122 up, 92 down), FDR < 0.05 (S3.6.p1, Fig. 7A); RPS6KC1 up (FDR < 0.01, S3.4.p2); TRIM63, FBXO32, TRAF6, FOXO1, FOXO3 unchanged (S3.4.p2); AR mRNA unchanged (FDR = 0.956, S3.3.p1)
